issues.t: Ignition coils fail and cause misfires
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, skips or shakes, the check engine light comes on or flashes, and the problem keeps coming back after repairs.
issues.why: The coil-on-plug ignition coils on the 3.9L V8 fail from heat and from water or oil collecting in the spark plug wells. Ford later extended coverage on the coils for 2003-2005 Thunderbirds; owners say 2002 models were left out.
issues.next: Have the misfire codes read and the plug wells checked for water or oil. Replace failed coils and fouled plugs together, and fix any leak that is filling the wells. Ford's extended coverage has very likely ended.

issues.t: Valve cover gaskets leak oil into spark plug wells
issues.sym: Oil seeping around the valve covers, a burning oil smell, and misfires when oil reaches the spark plugs.
issues.why: The valve cover gaskets harden and leak, and oil runs down into the spark plug wells. Ford extended coverage on valve cover gaskets for 2003 models.
issues.next: Replace the valve cover gaskets and clean the plug wells when coils or plugs are replaced. Many owners do both jobs at once.

issues.t: Water in spark plug wells causes misfire
issues.sym: Misfire codes and rough running, often after rain or a car wash.
issues.why: Water can drain from the cowl area under the wipers into the spark plug wells on Thunderbirds built through May 2004. Ford issued a bulletin for it, and owners report dealers modifying the cowl area.
issues.next: Have the plug wells dried and checked, and ask about the bulletin fix for the cowl drain. Replace any coil or plug that was damaged.

issues.t: Hydraulic cooling fan fails and engine overheats
issues.sym: Temperature gauge climbs in traffic or at idle, overheating, loss of power, or a rattle from the fan pump.
issues.why: The 2002 Thunderbird uses a hydraulically driven engine cooling fan. Ford issued bulletins for overheating from an inoperative fan and for a rattling fan pump.
issues.next: Stop driving if it overheats. Have the fan, pump and hydraulic lines checked; driving hot can damage the engine.

issues.t: Throttle warning light and reduced power
issues.sym: The throttle control warning light and check engine light come on, and the car goes into a low-power mode.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins for electronic throttle control codes (such as P2106 and P2135) and for sludge in the throttle body that causes rough idle and hard starts.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Cleaning the throttle body or a software update fixes some cases; others need a new throttle body or pedal sensor.

issues.t: Stalls when slowing down or turning
issues.sym: The engine quits or loses power when coasting to a stop, slowing, or turning, and may run rough with the check engine light on.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins for intermittent stalling and reduced power on deceleration. Owners also report rough running and stalling with the engine light on.
issues.next: Have a dealer check for the bulletin and any computer updates. Stalling in traffic is a safety risk, so do not put it off.

issues.t: Hard starting or flooding when cold
issues.sym: Long cranking before the engine starts in cold weather, or it floods and will not start.
issues.why: Ford published bulletins for flooding and extended cranking on cold starts.
issues.next: Ask a dealer whether the bulletin calibration update was done.

issues.t: Oil leak at the oil filter
issues.sym: Oil dripping under the front of the engine and a falling oil level.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins for oil leaking from the oil filter area on the 3.9L V8.
issues.next: Check the oil level now. A shop can fit the updated filter or seal.

issues.t: Delayed or harsh engagement into reverse
issues.sym: A pause and then a clunk when shifting into reverse.
issues.why: The five-speed automatic on cars built before September 2004 could get this from incorrectly made transmission fluid. Ford ran a customer satisfaction program.
issues.next: Ask a Ford dealer whether the fluid program was done on your VIN. A fluid change often fixes it.

issues.t: Transmission shift solenoid problems
issues.sym: Erratic or harsh shifting and a check engine light.
issues.why: Ford extended the emissions warranty on the automatic transmission solenoids of these years, and also published a bulletin for harsh shifts on some 2003 cars.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Solenoid repair is far cheaper than a new transmission.

issues.t: Transmission fluid leak at bellhousing
issues.sym: Red fluid dripping between the engine and transmission.
issues.why: Ford issued a bulletin for fluid leaking at the converter housing on cars built in certain dates, and another for a leaking pan drain plug.
issues.next: Have the leak source found and keep the fluid topped up.

issues.t: Water leaks from the convertible top or hardtop
issues.sym: Water or moisture in the cabin or in the top storage compartment after rain.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins on water leaks around the convertible top and removable hardtop and on moisture in the storage area.
issues.next: Have the seals and drains checked and adjusted. Dry the carpet to avoid mold and electrical trouble.

issues.t: Battery drains and car will not crank
issues.sym: The battery is dead after sitting for a few days.
issues.why: Ford issued a bulletin for a module that keeps drawing current with the car off, and another for no-starts from a discharged battery.
issues.next: Have a parasitic draw test done. A dealer may need to update or replace the module causing the drain.

issues.t: Steering squeaks when turning
issues.sym: A squeak or rubbing noise when turning the wheel, especially at parking speeds.
issues.why: Ford issued several bulletins for steering gear squeaks and noise on the Thunderbird.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the bulletin fix. It is usually not a safety problem.

issues.t: ABS warning light on
issues.sym: The ABS light stays on and anti-lock braking is off.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins for ABS codes C1145 and C1155, which point to the front wheel speed sensors.
issues.next: Have the ABS codes read. Normal brakes still work, but ABS will not until it is fixed.

issues.t: Rear defroster or radio antenna stops working
issues.sym: The rear defroster grid does not clear and radio reception is poor.
issues.why: The antenna is built into the rear glass and its terminal tab can come loose. Ford published repair bulletins.
issues.next: A shop can re-attach the tab with a repair kit.

issues.t: Climate control stuck on full heat
issues.sym: The automatic climate control blows only hot air or cannot set different temperatures side to side.
issues.why: Ford issued a bulletin for the dual automatic temperature control getting stuck on full heat.
issues.next: Have the climate control actuators and module checked.

issues.t: Door window does not drop or seal properly
issues.sym: The frameless door glass does not drop a little when the door opens, or moves erratically.
issues.why: The window short-drop feature can lose its calibration. Ford issued bulletins on it.
issues.next: A dealer can recalibrate the window.

issues.t: Steering wheel radio buttons short out
issues.sym: Radio controls on the steering wheel stop working or act on their own.
issues.why: Owners report the steering wheel radio switches shorting out.
issues.next: Have the switch and clockspring checked. Airbag precautions are needed for this repair.

issues.t: Driver seat belt can be cut by the seat recliner (recall)
issues.sym: Fraying or a cut in the driver's lap belt near the seat recliner.
issues.why: The edge of the seat recliner could cut into the driver's lap belt webbing.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the free repair done. Replace any cut belt.

issues.t: Head gasket leak and overheating
issues.sym: Coolant loss, overheating, white exhaust smoke or milky oil.
issues.why: The 3.8L V6 has a long history of head gasket failures. Ford revised the gasket, but 1996 owners still reported failures, and Ford issued bulletins on leaks around the head gasket.
issues.next: Stop driving if it overheats. Have a cooling system pressure test and combustion leak test done.

issues.t: Front cover gasket leaks coolant into oil
issues.sym: Coolant level dropping, a sweet smell, or coolant in the engine oil.
issues.why: The engine front cover gasket on the 3.8L can leak coolant. Ford ran an owner notification program and changed the bolt torque and gasket.
issues.next: If coolant is in the oil, stop driving and have it fixed before the bearings are damaged.

issues.t: Plastic intake manifold cracks and leaks coolant
issues.sym: Coolant leaking at the front of the engine, overheating, or a sudden large coolant leak.
issues.why: The 4.6L V8 used a plastic intake manifold with a coolant passage that can crack. Ford added extra coverage and later settled a class action; that coverage has ended.
issues.next: If you see coolant at the front of the intake, have it replaced before it fails suddenly. Use an updated manifold with an aluminum coolant crossover.

issues.t: Late 1-2 shift and harsh 3-4 shift
issues.sym: The car hangs in first gear before shifting, or bangs into fourth gear.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins for these shift problems on the 4R70W automatic, including 4.6L cars built through June 1996, and for computer calibration updates.
issues.next: Have a shop check the fluid and codes and ask about the bulletin fixes before agreeing to a rebuild.

issues.t: Shudder from torque converter clutch
issues.sym: A shudder or vibration at steady speeds, like driving over rumble strips, especially in third or fourth gear.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins for torque converter clutch shudder on these transmissions.
issues.next: Have the fluid changed with the correct fluid first. If it continues, the torque converter may need replacing.

issues.t: Heater core leaks
issues.sym: Wet front carpet, a sweet coolant smell, fogging windows, or coolant loss.
issues.why: The heater core can leak. Ford issued a bulletin on heater core leaks, and owners report replacing them.
issues.next: Have the cooling system pressure tested. Replacing the heater core takes the dashboard apart.

issues.t: A/C compressor fails
issues.sym: The A/C blows warm or the compressor makes noise.
issues.why: Ford issued a bulletin on A/C compressors failing from too little refrigerant oil, and owners report replacing them.
issues.next: Have the system checked for leaks and correct oil level when the compressor is replaced.

issues.t: Power window stops or pops
issues.sym: A window stops working, or makes a pop at the top or bottom of its travel.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins for popping power window mechanisms, and owners report windows that quit.
issues.next: Have the window motor and regulator checked.

issues.t: Brake pulsation or pull when braking
issues.sym: A shaking steering wheel or pedal when braking, or the car pulls to one side.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins on brake vibration and on pulling while braking, sometimes from worn front arm or strut bushings.
issues.next: Have the rotors, pads and front bushings checked.

issues.t: ABS light stays on
issues.sym: The amber ABS light stays on.
issues.why: Ford issued a procedure for diagnosing the ABS light, and owners report sensors and wiring problems.
issues.next: Have the ABS codes read. Normal brakes still work.

issues.t: Windshield wipers stop working
issues.sym: Wipers stop working or work only sometimes.
issues.why: Ford issued bulletins noting the wiper motor may need replacing when the wipers stop working.
issues.next: Have the wiper switch and motor tested.

issues.t: Check engine light from water in the air intake
issues.sym: Check engine light after driving in heavy rain, sometimes with rough running.
issues.why: Water can enter the air inlet and air filter and contaminate the mass air flow sensor. Ford issued bulletins on it.
issues.next: Have the air filter box checked for water and the sensor tested.

issues.t: Long cranking and stalling after sitting
issues.sym: Long cranking and stalling after the car has sat for a while.
issues.why: The idle air control valve can stick. Ford issued a bulletin on it.
issues.next: Have the idle air control valve cleaned or replaced.

issues.t: Blower can stop and limit defrosting (recall)
issues.sym: Little or no air from the vents, making it hard to clear the windshield.
issues.why: The climate control module on some 1996 cars could make the blower malfunction.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the free repair done.

issues.t: Driver door latch may not hold (recall)
issues.sym: The driver door may not stay closed in a crash if it is only partly latched.
issues.why: When closed only to the secondary latch position, the driver door latch on some 1996 cars was too weak.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and always close the door fully.
